title: Father protests outside Coimbatore collectorate over student suicide

tea.why: A father and relatives protested after a 16-year-old student died by suicide following alleged caste-based harassment at a school.
tea.want: Protesters demanded justice and accountability regarding the alleged caste discrimination and harassment.
tea.changed: Oct 23: The victim's father staged a demonstration outside the district collectorate demanding the arrest of those responsible.

summary: Following the suicide of a 16-year-old student in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, the victim's parents, relatives, and members of various progressive organizations staged a demonstration outside the Coimbatore district collectorate on Friday. The family alleged that the student faced caste-based harassment and taunts from classmates and a teacher after disclosing his caste and food choices during a scholarship inquiry. The protesters demanded immediate arrests and accountability from school authorities, stating they would not receive the body until action was taken. In response, police stated that four individuals—including the principal, a teacher, and two students—were booked and detained or sent to an observation home, while the school management suspended the principal and teacher.
demands: Arrest of all individuals responsible for the student's death
Accountability from school authorities regarding caste harassment
Establishment of a social justice student force in every school
response: Police stated that an impartial investigation was ongoing and that four accused individuals, including the school principal, a teacher, and two students, had been detained and booked for abetment to suicide.

arrests.text: Two students sent to an observation home for 15 days; school principal, a teacher and two students among four held.

deaths.text: 16-year-old Class XI student found dead at his residence

updates.text: The victim's father, relatives, and organization members protested outside the Coimbatore district collectorate.
